lines.en: It's Sunday morning. I'm not busy.
I see my neighbour downstairs.
"Do you want to have lunch together?"
We walk to the market.
It's very hot today.
I have a kopi, less sugar.
My neighbour has a teh, no sugar.
lines.zh: 邻居喝一杯奶茶，不要糖。

lines.en: We have chicken rice. Not spicy!
My neighbour is a good cook.
I can't cook. "Can you teach me?"
lines.zh: 我不会做饭。"你可以教我吗？"

lines.en: We return the tray together.
lines.zh: 我们一起把托盘还回去。

lines.en: It's a nice Sunday.
lines.zh: 这是一个愉快的星期天。

dialogue.title: 试听课的爸爸
dialogue.setting: 星期六上午，林先生带儿子来上试听课，他在前台等。

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: Hi! My son is in the trial class.
lines.zh: 你好！我儿子在上试听课。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Welcome! Each class is 90 minutes.

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: 90 minutes? I'm very hungry.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Do you want to have lunch? The market is near here.
lines.zh: 你要不要去吃午饭？巴刹就在附近。

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: Is the chicken rice good?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes! It's very nice. Not expensive.

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: How much is it?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: It's 5 dollars.

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: Thank you. Can I have your phone number?
lines.zh: 谢谢。可以给我你的电话号码吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes. I will WhatsApp you at noon.
lines.zh: 可以。中午我会发 WhatsApp 给你。

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: Thank you! Do you want a kopi?
lines.zh: 谢谢！你要不要一杯咖啡？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, please! Kopi O, less sugar.

lines.speaker: Mr Lim
lines.en: See you at noon!
